source: What the AllWISE reader must read and refuse in W2, W3 and W4, beside W1. header is a search that selects all four bands' magnitudes and errors, as IRSA's TAP service writes them for csv. The fluxes are worked by hand from F = F0 10^(-m/2.5) and sigma_F = F ln(10)/2.5 sigma_m with the zero points of data/wise-zero-points.json (W1 309.540, W2 171.787, W3 31.674, W4 8.363 Jy): W1 15 +- 0.1 is 3.0954e-4 +- 2.8509e-5; W2 14 +- 0.2 is 4.315094e-4 +- 7.948698e-5; W3 11 +- 0.3 is 1.260965e-3 +- 3.484174e-4; W4 8 +- 0.5 is 5.276696e-3 +- 2.430008e-3; a W4 limit of 17 is 1.325446e-6. rel is picked: the hand work is kept to six digits and 1e-4 is wider than that. A band whose magnitude and error are both empty has no measurement (AllWISE, Explanatory Supplement section II.1.a: a ph_qual of X leaves w?mpro and w?sigmpro null), so the source has no measurement in it. Every other refusal names the column. real is a search of AllWISE around Sgr A* (RA 266.416837083, Dec -29.007810556, radius 0.002778 deg, which is 10 arcsec), fetched from IRSA's TAP service (table allwise_p3as_psd) on 2026-10-30 with W2 to W4: both sources have a W2 limit (w2sigmpro is empty), a W3 detection and no W4. The values are worked by hand as above: W2 6.05 is 0.653116 Jy and 6.59 is 0.3971827; W3 -4.719 +- 0.142 is 2445.135 +- 319.7915 and -5.121 +- 0.093 is 3540.812 +- 303.2924.
